scope: Local Application and synthetic Worker/MCP completion reads; no live tests/deployment

checks.name: App release build and three Worker dry builds
Changed prose, whitespace and document validation

acceptance_evidence: Sixteen neutral cases agree across Application, TypeScript and actual Workspace/MCP history, preserving original IDs, archive flags and separate completion/occurrence dates.
Matching command snapshots supply stored text/notes. Missing snapshots explicitly select current-task details, including historical null notes without borrowing current notes.
Normalized detail search, inclusive seven-digit UTC fraction bounds, timestamp/revision/stable ordering and guarded pages match both runtimes.
A forty-one-record query retains all canonical records rather than inheriting the legacy recent-completed limit.

The active epoch-guarded document/snapshot batch returns current revisions; stale pages, changed/deleted epochs, malformed sources and mismatched snapshots fail without partial or optimistic empty data.

MCP discovery advertises tasks:read and read-only behavior. Missing grants fail at both boundaries, another profile sees no history and reads preserve command/store state after authorization epoch establishment.
Zero upstream writes occur; no completion, restore, projection or reward is changed.
limitations: Restore commands, repeated Todo completion-cycle modeling, Habit activity history and production history UI remain Pending.
Current-task fallback describes current details rather than proven original text; exact task IDs support renamed-task lookup.
Real host/model behavior, mobile accessibility and live qualification remain unrun.
